articles.summary: Altisource, a leading provider and marketplace for the real estate and mortgage industries, proudly announces that three of its innovative technology businesses—Hubzu®, Equator®, and RentRange®—have been distinguished by HousingWire in their annual HW TECH100™ Real Estate list for 2024. This prestigious award recognizes the 100 most innovative technology companies serving the real estate sector.
articles.title: Altisource Technology Businesses Shine in HousingWire’s Tech100 Real Estate Companies of 2024
